mapper.select: SELECT endorsement_id, policy_number, endorsement_type, change_reason, previous_content, new_content, endorsement_status, underwriting_request_id, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_endorsement WHERE endorsement_id = #{endorsementId}

SELECT endorsement_id, policy_number, endorsement_type, change_reason, previous_content, new_content, endorsement_status, underwriting_request_id, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_endorsement WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} AND endorsement_status = 'APPLIED' ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT 1
